title: ProjectEntry
description: JSON Schema for an individual Cradle project metadata entry.

title.description: Human-readable display title of the project.

path.description: Relative project folder path starting with 'projects/' and ending with a trailing slash.

dateAdded.description: ISO 8601 date string when project was first introduced, or null.

thumbnailHash.description: First 8 hex characters of the SHA-256 hash of thumbnail.svg.
